ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this list.

ownerEmail.description: The email of the owner of the list.

sharedWith.description: List of user emails this list is shared with.

updatedAt.description: When the list was last modified.

isArchived.description: Whether the list has been archived.

ShoppingItem.title: ShoppingItem
ShoppingItem.description: Represents an individual item inside a shopping list.

name.description: The name of the item (e.g., 'Leche semidesnatada').

category.description: The determined category of the product.

checked.description: Whether the item has been marked as purchased.

updatedAt.description: When the item was last updated.

addedBy.description: UID of the user who added this item.

/lists/{listId}.description: Primary collection of shopping lists owned or shared with users.

/lists/{listId}/items/{itemId}.description: Subcollection under each list containing the items layout.
